description:
Connect your Mextic account to ask about your vehicle fleet in plain language,
without opening the dashboard or generating reports.

You can ask about:

• Location and mileage — where each unit is right now, how far it traveled, and
where and for how long it was stopped.
• Fuel — km/L per unit and period, plus detected refuels and extractions.
• Maintenance — upcoming and overdue services by odometer or date.

defaultPrompt: Where are my vehicles right now?
Any vehicle with upcoming or overdue maintenance?
How is my fleet's fuel efficiency this month?
